  "required_fixes": [
    "R1 (remaining) — Validate nested rated-target counts before inferring quiet statistics. crates/desktop-core/src/red_team.rs:298 reduces risk_profile[].targets_by_type to a positive-count predicate, silently ignoring invalid counts and malformed containers. For example, {\"risk_profile\":[{\"risk_rating\":\"LOW\",\"total\":0,\"targets_by_type\":[{\"name\":\"MODEL\",\"count\":-1}]}]} reaches statistics():315 as quiet and produces successful scans=0, targets=0. A non-array targets_by_type or 65 nested target entries is also accepted. The pinned v1 observations parser rejects all three; D039 and prior R1 require a validated entirely quiet source before missing totals become zero. Acceptance: validate each reported nested group, entry and count, including its bounds, before deciding quietness; negative/fractional/missing counts, malformed groups and oversized nested arrays must produce invalid statistics rather than zero tiles. Add raw production-interface fixtures proving independent scan/model/skill sources remain usable, and preserve valid all-zero nested groups.",
    "R4 — Malformed pagination metadata can still establish completeness and false absence. crates/desktop-core/src/red_team.rs:372 obtains total_items with chained get calls without validating the pagination container; {\"data\":[],\"pagination\":\"invalid\"} is treated as an ordinary short page with no total and marked complete. The same page is accepted by proves_no_scans():405, so management.rs:1680 can turn a statistics 404 plus malformed confirmation into successful no_scans=true. The count_capped branch also treats an explicitly null flag as false, although the v1 contract rejects a present non-boolean flag. This bypasses the intended distinction between invalid, unknown and confirmed empty sources across scan and attack pages. Acceptance: reject malformed pagination containers and present non-boolean count_capped values before computing coverage; these replies must never prove no scans or all attacks read. Add raw fixtures for the 404-confirmation path and ordinary list/attack reads. Preserve valid pagination objects with an omitted total, complete-empty results and normal 100/100/50 coverage."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [],
  "optional_suggestions": [],
  "limitations": [
    "Read-only review: no application files were changed, no application/endpoints were launched, and no credentials were accessed. Rust producer behavior for the counterexamples was traced in source rather than newly executed; the required negative Rust fixtures remain to be added.",
    "Independently recomputed all four supplied fingerprints, verified 528 source-inventory entries and 254 referenced artifacts, checked run input/log/artifact hashes, and verified the passing C12 attempt-04 and P03 attempt-02 predecessor receipt chains.",
    "Executed in-memory probes through the actual pinned v1 observations/protocol functions. They reject negative, malformed and oversized nested target groups, malformed pagination and a null count_capped flag; valid empty-page and quiet-skill baselines pass. Both reference files match commit 74754c02. These probes establish the reference behavior, not execution of the Rust implementation.",
    "Prior R2's accumulated attack coverage/short-page presentation, R3's capped-total projection, the unknown-label suggestion and the tenant-header probe follow-up are addressed by scoped source and added tests. R1's top-level failure-envelope, missing-total and breakdown-limit cases are improved; nested validation remains as described above.",
    "Prior E1 is closed. The fixture now supplies 100 skill rows, the performance driver waits for the 100-skill completeness statement, and current native evidence records 100 pseudonyms. All retained performance samples meet the unchanged registered budgets: Red Team opening p95 146.76 ms, 1,000 attacks p95 368.36 ms, Model/skill opening p95 215.61 ms, and maximum process-tree RSS 396.5 MiB against 450 MiB. Every attack timing repetition records ten pages and every Model/skill repetition records three source reads.",
    "Retained current-run logs report 343 frontend tests, 143 Rust library tests and eight scoped HTTP integration tests passing; all 45 recorded mutation probes are caught. Eight current C13 native checks pass on executable c07732f10a8a5aa136a5eb5f373a33d5cfaa896eee4c3bb0eb88c4f6cdd3ee0c. The retained C01-C12 native records reference the earlier d635bda20b6a0dd27b01eb7ba407567bc25e53be4bc21ea9180ddea843497cf6 executable and are historical evidence, not current integrated native reruns.",
    "Native acceptance uses synthetic loopback services; spoken VoiceOver output, live service qualification and signed/installed packages are not established. This verdict assesses C13; fingerprinting the integrated C13-C15 tree does not constitute cumulative P04 approval or adjudicate C14/C15 findings."
  ],
